capabilities: Render a live print-formatted page preview (A4, Letter, A3, custom) in the sidebar
Sync preview scrolling with the editor cursor position
Split overflowing paragraphs, lists, tables, and code blocks cleanly across pages
Add page breaks, multi-column layouts, and centered blocks with //page, //column, and //center commands
Export documents as PDFs with heading-based bookmarks and Unicode support
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The README appears truncated and ends mid-sentence while describing custom CSS stylesheets.
motivation: The README says it 'streamlines your writing workflow by combining document editing and publication layout design into one seamless process.'
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown without print formatting, so writers cannot see line wraps, margins, or page breaks while editing, and exports lack interactive PDF outlines.
summary: Print-layout preview plugin that shows a real-time A4-style page view of Markdown in the sidebar and exports it to a PDF with clickable bookmarks.
